searchText: Hello, I'm spamming a bit devnet8. My idea is to crate many huge SC (64k size). I need to experiment on the network behavior when there is a block that uses lots of hugse smart contracts. This is a killer block for zkProvers. But I'd like to see if regular clients can handle it. Currently the faucet goes faster that the burned eth deploying the smart contracts. But this forces us to keep a person in front of the faucet using VPNs, and so just to get test ETH. I'd ask if I can I save the time of an intern and get just an important amount of devnett8ETH without having to spend precious time solving capchas. This is the account where we need ETH: 0xe31857c5e4Ac8778e85aE3f0127dAbDCe1E175F1 Thank you in advance. <@412614104222531604> ^ how much eth were you thinking? Arround 1M ? yeah I can't do that 😄 That could take over the whole validator set Ok, then don't worry. We are keeping with the faucet. Lets see where we can get. I'm expecting arround 1 month to create the SCs. I could use Sepolia, but not sure if it's a good idea. you have 1M eth on sepolia? 😂 Deploying a Big SC in sepolia costs 0.000101564387300064 ETH Compared to 4.783010361845104086 ETH in devnet8 it's 47800x less. So in Sepolia I would need arround 21ETH to do the job. (I have arround 8K in one account 🙂 ) I can trade you some Sepolia ETH for Devnet8ETH ! 🙂
